title: NRF2-CD36 Axis-Mediated Oleic Acid-Induced Milk Fat Production in Dairy Cow Mammary Epithelial Cells.
authors: Zhang, Caiyan; Sui, Fengxian; Liu, Meiyan; Xie, Yalin; Su, Jiadi; Gao, Jing; Lin, Ye; Yang, Yang; Hou, Xiaoming
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究OA通过NRF2-CD36轴调控奶牛乳腺上皮细胞乳脂合成，涉及分子对接和ChIP验证NRF2与CD36启动子结合，但核心是代谢调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: Oleic acid (OA)-enriched diet significantly enhances CD36 expression and promotes milk fat production in the mammary gland. However, the mechanisms by which OA upregulates this process are unknown. Here, GC-MS analysis and molecular docking were used to assess OA-CD36 binding, while gene expression and ChIP assays clarified the OA-mediated regulation of CD36 and milk fat synthesis. The results showed that CD36 is highly expressed in the lactating mammary tissues of dairy cows and positively regulates milk fat production. OA enters dairy cow mammary epithelial cells via direct binding to CD36. OA stimulation elevates the CD36 expression and translocation. ChIP assays confirmed CD36 as a target gene of NRF2. OA also enhances NRF2 expression and nuclear translocation, which in turn upregulates CD36 expression and function. This study elucidates the NRF2-CD36 axis as a regulator of OA-driven milk fat synthesis in mammary tissue, offering practical value for dairy industry nutritional strategies.
abstract_zh: 富含油酸（OA）的日粮显著增强CD36表达并促进乳腺中的乳脂生成。然而，OA上调这一过程的机制尚不清楚。本研究采用气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）分析和分子对接评估OA-CD36结合，同时通过基因表达和染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）实验阐明OA介导的CD36调控及乳脂合成。结果表明，CD36在泌乳期奶牛乳腺组织中高表达，并正向调控乳脂生成。OA通过直接结合CD36进入奶牛乳腺上皮细胞。OA刺激提高CD36表达及转位。ChIP实验确认CD36为NRF2的靶基因。OA还增强NRF2表达及核转位，进而上调CD36表达与功能。本研究阐明了NRF2-CD36轴作为乳腺组织中OA驱动乳脂合成的调控因子，为乳业营养策略提供了实用价值。
